17 · Frequently asked questions

Helpful answers for parents

Contact the school office for confirmed policies and current information.

How can I ask about admission?

Submit the admission enquiry form on this page or call the school at 03115286640 to confirm the process and availability.

Where can I confirm the fee structure?

Contact the school office for the latest approved class-wise fee schedule, due dates and payment methods.

Can parents check attendance and results online?

This website design includes the intended parent portal experience. Secure login, student-linked access and live records must be configured in the backend before launch.

How do I arrange a parent-teacher meeting?

Use the meeting request form or contact the school. A request is not a confirmed appointment until the school responds.

Will absence and fee alerts be sent automatically?

Automatic alerts require a configured backend and an approved email, SMS or WhatsApp Business provider. Delivery status should be tracked.
